units.source_text: 明年源氏大臣四十岁，应举行庆祝大会。

en.t: Next year Minister Genji would turn forty, and a grand celebration was to be held.

units.source_text: 自朝廷以下，各处都加紧准备贺寿。

en.t: From the court downward, people everywhere hurried to prepare birthday congratulations.

units.source_text: 今年秋季，源氏太政大臣官位晋升，照准太上天皇待遇增加封户，

en.t: That autumn, Genji, the Grand Minister, was promoted in rank, and his fiefs were increased in accordance with the treatment of a retired emperor,
and annual offices and ranks were also granted to him.

units.source_text: 即不如此，源氏之家早已万般富足，毫无缺憾了。

en.t: Even without this, Genji's household had already been wealthy in every way and lacked nothing at all.

units.source_text: 但冷泉帝还是引用古代罕有的先例，为源氏设置许多院司。

en.t: Yet Emperor Reizei still invoked a rare ancient precedent and established many administrative officers for Genji.

units.source_text: 因此源氏身份异常高贵，出入宫禁很不自由，反而拘束了。

en.t: As a result, Genji's status became exceptionally exalted, and entering and leaving the palace became very restricted, making him feel constrained instead.

units.source_text: 但冷泉帝还嫌不够优待，他常恨不能把皇位让与源氏，

en.t: But Emperor Reizei still felt that he had not favored him enough, and he often regretted that he could not yield the throne to Genji,

units.source_text: 恐被世人指责，为此朝夕愁叹。

en.t: fearing that the world would condemn him, and for this he grieved and sighed morning and evening.
